description: C2 gate finding (A2 protocol on gemini-2.5-flash): the cache-path RI fit SUCCEEDS and returns n = 1.850, yet the model restates n = 1.999 in prose and 1.871 in the table cell (4 of 5 live runs). The value-bound gate must strip 1.999 and 1.871 while the correct restatements 1.850 and 1.85 survive.
